```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
data <- read_delim("final_eval.csv", escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE)
library("irr")
data_calc <- data[, 4:6]
print(kappam.fleiss(data_calc))

data_sum <- data[c('SecI', 'Sum')]
result <- data_sum %>%
  mutate(sum_check = ifelse(Sum > 1, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(SecI) %>%
  summarise(sum_final = sum(sum_check)) %>%
  filter(sum_final >= 2) %>%
  pull(SecI)

write.table(result, file = "final_relevant_security_indicators.txt", col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
````
